ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels and 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region; dense black mottling and contiguous dark bands along the right lobe trailing edge and tip; concentrated dark focal spot at the base near the median notch; sparse black speckling on the left lobe periphery.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge is moderately smooth with minor irregularities; right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations and jagged peaks isolated from the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on the upper boundaries of both lobes, tapering to acute tips with a slight upturn at the lateral extremes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of roughly 6-8 circular dark pixel clusters on the upper-mid quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Clear detection of multiple parallel vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) on the inner right lobe; faint horizontal scratches visible on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation and serration on the right lobe trailing edge suggesting prior tissue loss; extensive rake mark scarring on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique vertically-oriented dark oval patch at the fluke base, centered on the median notch.
